summary: Linear's OAuth setup is straightforward and does not require a formal review process for private integrations. Developers can register apps directly in their workspace settings and use standard OAuth 2.0 flows with PKCE.

approval.notes: No approval process is mentioned for standard OAuth applications.

steps.title: Create OAuth Application
steps.detail: Navigate to the settings page to create a new OAuth2 application.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.detail: Register the callback URLs that your application will use to receive authorization codes.

steps.title: Implement Authorization Flow
steps.detail: Redirect users to the Linear authorization URL with required parameters including client_id, redirect_uri, and scopes.

nuances: It is highly recommended to create a dedicated workspace for managing OAuth applications.
Linear supports PKCE, which is recommended for secure authorization.
Applications can be configured to act on behalf of a user or as an 'app' actor within a workspace.
agent_can_do: Draft the application name and description
Define required scopes based on integration needs
Store client credentials securely in environment variables
Generate code challenges for the PKCE flow
human_must_do: Sign in to the Linear workspace
Create the application in the settings console
Copy the generated Client ID and Client Secret
Authorize the application during the initial testing phase
